audience: sales and outreach teams that run email campaigns and manage leads in Mailshake

useCases.title: Read the latest real replies
useCases.text: List the newest replies as plain text. Filter to real answers, or skip out-of-office messages, bounces and unsubscribe notices.

useCases.title: Review how a campaign performed
useCases.text: List the campaigns and find the campaign id. Then read its message sequence and list the recipients who opened, clicked or replied.

useCases.title: Check recent opens and link clicks
useCases.text: List the most recent email opens and clicks on tracked links. Use them to see which messages get attention.

useCases.title: Pause a campaign while you fix it
useCases.text: Stop all sending for a campaign now. Emails already in a batch are not stopped. Resume the campaign when the fix is ready.

useCases.title: Mark leads as won, lost or ignored
useCases.text: Close a lead as won or lost, ignore it, or reopen it for review. The change does not send any email.
